sst-analysis.limitations: Daily L4 foundation SST analysis, partly interpolated. Native 0.05° grid spacing is not independent observational accuracy. Surface only; not bottom temperature or fish presence. Error support is not a confidence interval.
sst-analysis.coverage_denominator: All requested source grid cells, including land and masked cells; repeated for each forecast frame

chlorophyll-observation.license: NOAA public data; attribute NOAA CoastWatch
chlorophyll-observation.limitations: Daily NOAA NPP/NOAA-20 merged VIIRS OCI ocean-color observation; clouds and failed retrievals remain gaps. Native 0.0375° latitude by 0.0375° longitude grid spacing; chlorophyll is not bait biomass or immediate feeding activity.
chlorophyll-observation.coverage_denominator: All requested source grid cells, including land and masked cells; repeated for each forecast frame

wcofs-surface-forecast.license: Public NOAA model data; retain attribution
wcofs-surface-forecast.limitations: Approximately 4 km model with three-hour output and at most 72-hour forecast. NOAA regular-grid interpolation is retained; no SkipperCast spatial or temporal gap filling. Surface flow is not bottom flow, boat drift or fish movement. Assimilates SST and HF radar; agreement with those inputs is not independent validation.
wcofs-surface-forecast.coverage_denominator: All requested source grid cells, including land and masked cells; repeated for each forecast frame

bluefin.range_meaning: No locally validated single surface-temperature optimum. Fish use multiple depths and forage fields.

dorado.range_meaning: Warm-water and floating-material context; no locally validated numeric optimum applied.

interpretation: Dated physical habitat context. Species thermal references and gradients are transparent search clues, not calibrated catch scores, legal permission or comfort ratings.
